_readme: FIAT PLACES - the Outskirts (12 Oct): the zone's tab and its three sites' bands (688x296, art/places/<slug>.png, UI.place_slug of the name). One file a job, written straight to its live name ('single').
As the other places: the zone rides art/places/the_estate.png as its style image, the sites art/places/ransacked_streets.png. A missing place keeps the drawn skyline until it's made.

Run: godot --headless --script res://tools/pixellab_batch_v2.gd ++ --manifest res://tools/pixellab_places_outskirts_manifest.json   (++ --dry-run to list; one that came out wrong: ++ --only <slug> ++ --force).

jobs.description: Pixel art, wide side-on panorama of the edge of a dead British town at dusk: a ring road on an embankment, allotment sheds and bean poles, the glasshouses and flat roof of an out-of-town garden centre, a farm's steel barn and silage clamp beyond a hedge line, pylons marching off across wet fields, the estate's tower blocks small on the horizon. Muted blue-grey and green-grey palette with sparse warm orange lights, low cloud. Quiet, not busy; no people, no text. The skyline's interest sits in a band across the middle of the frame (it is shown as a thin strip cut from the middle); flat, even detail side to side, darker at the bottom edge.
jobs._where: the zone tab (372x56, cut from the middle)

jobs.description: Pixel art, wide ground-level view of a council allotment site after a collapse: rows of overgrown plots, patched sheds of corrugated sheet and old doors, a water butt and a bath used as a trough, bean canes fallen over, a polytunnel torn open, a chained gate in a chain-link fence, a bonfire's ash heap, overcast evening. Muted blue-grey palette, dark navy shadows, overcast evening light, one or two warm orange windows or lamps. The left third and the bottom quarter stay darker and lower in detail (the title and the timer sit there); the interest is in the centre. No people, no text, no readable signage or lettering.
jobs._where: the site's band: the Runs card (501x200) and behind the run's clock (608x200)
